console_errors.message: A stale Turbopack error remained in browser logs after a prior Turbopack dev-server attempt. Classic Next dev server returned a clean 307 redirect from /settings/users to /authentication/sign-in for unauthenticated access.

blockers: No authenticated local browser session with manage_users was available, so /settings/users redirected to /authentication/sign-in and the fixed dashboard view could not be visually inspected.
The first Turbopack dev-server attempt produced a local Turbopack panic on the sign-in route; classic Next dev server was used to confirm the auth redirect.
next_action: Publish only as draft and request authenticated/staging visual verification before marking ready.
